title: Lighthouse of Batumi - 1883
creator: Sosotedrd
credit: "Lighthouse of Batumi - 1883" by Sosotedrd, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons (scan border cropped, shown in greyscale)
notes: Two statuses for the same file, recorded 2026-10-22 (round 2). (1) The Commons file page carries the template 'PD-old (assumed)' with the CC Public Domain Mark. (2) The file's structured data (M121879918) say P6216 copyright status = copyrighted, P275 licence = CC BY-SA 4.0, P7482 source = original creation by uploader; the EXIF holds camera data (ISO 80, f/9, 1/80 s, 17 mm), i.e. the uploader photographed the postcard. Read from the reviewer's check; a re-check from here hit Commons API rate limits (HTTP 429).

Until the status is cleared the page follows the stricter reading on all three languages: 'Sosotedrd, «Lighthouse of Batumi - 1883», CC BY-SA 4.0' with links to the file page and to https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/, plus what was changed.

Adaptation: the black scanner border is cut from the file (50 px each side) and the page shows it with CSS filter: grayscale(1). Under CC BY-SA 4.0 that is an adapted work, so share-alike applies: this cropped, greyscale version is shared under CC BY-SA 4.0 too, and the credit line names both changes. Under the public-domain reading neither step has conditions.
No copy with a known publisher (LoC, a museum) found in the open collections (assets.mjs 'Batum lighthouse', 2026-10-22). Swapping in such a copy, or removing the inset, would end the ambiguity.
Resized for the page on 2026-10-22 (round 3): 1180x1856 -> 480x755 px, JPEG re-encoded; it is shown at about 230 px wide, so nothing visible is lost.
